T1_signed_receipt.label: Signed receipt
T1_signed_receipt.claim: One provider identity signed an assignment-bound receipt.

T2_canary_audited.label: Canary audited
T2_canary_audited.claim: Provider has recent hidden deterministic audit evidence.

T3_redundant_agreement.label: Redundant agreement
T3_redundant_agreement.claim: Independent browser providers produced matching deterministic receipt hashes.

T1_ring_baseline.label: Ring baseline
T1_ring_baseline.claim: One ring member produced a signed receipt with ring metadata.

T2_paired_ring_receipt.label: Paired ring receipt
T2_paired_ring_receipt.claim: Two browser ring members agreed on deterministic output and token hashes.

T3_majority_ring_receipt.label: Majority ring receipt
T3_majority_ring_receipt.claim: A majority browser ring agreed on deterministic output and token hashes.

T4_max_ring_quorum_receipt.label: Max ring quorum receipt
T4_max_ring_quorum_receipt.claim: A majority of up to twelve browser ring members agreed on deterministic output and token hashes.

T4_requester_accepted.label: Requester accepted
T4_requester_accepted.claim: Requester countersigned the verifier-accepted agreement and spend.

runtimeCompatibility.capabilityAction: Use doppler-gpu@0.5.1 or newer with capability-aware kernelPathPolicy; browsers without shader-f16 run the declared f32 fallback lane.

cloud_heavy.claim: Cloud coordinator carries assignment, prompt, output, receipts, and ledger.

hybrid_p2p_anchor.claim: WebRTC DataChannel is primary prompt/output/full-receipt transit while cloud anchors assignment, signaling metadata, receipt hash, agreement hash, points, and reputation.

p2p_ring_traffic.claim: Ring provider consensus moves over WebRTC while cloud remains the agreement and ledger anchor.

artifactPreflight.manifestPath: artifactPolicy.paths.manifest resolved under artifactPolicy.baseUrl or REPLOID_POOL_MODEL_BASE_URL

strict_hash_same_runtime_profile.claim: Bitwise token/output agreement is valid only inside the same declared browser runtime profile bucket.

hardware_homogeneous.claim: Providers are grouped by coarse WebGPU hardware and browser buckets before strict hash quorum is evaluated.

drift_observed.claim: Divergence is recorded with token/logit evidence and cannot produce strict quorum trust.

tolerance_verified.claim: Reserved for future Doppler top-k/logprob evidence; disabled until evidence bounds exist.

commit_reveal_v1.claim: Assignment input may travel privately before compute; providers must anchor private outputs before revealed result evidence can influence quorum or rewards.

new_provider_quarantine.claim: New or weakly proven browser providers may run low-value work but cannot alone create high-trust outcomes.

trusted_browser_provider.claim: Providers with accepted receipts and clean audit history may participate in higher-trust rings.

quarantined_provider.claim: Providers with model/runtime violations, repeated failures, or failed canaries are excluded from routing.

direct_firestore_projection_v1.claim: Current production mode mutates assignment/job projections directly while storing receipts, commitments, reveals, ledger, and reputation as separate records.

append_only_event_sourced_v1.claim: Scale mode: providers write isolated events and a coordinator reducer materializes job state outside hot document contention.

runtimeCompatibility.capabilityAction: Use a browser/GPU that exposes shader-f16, or choose another enabled text model.
Use doppler-gpu@0.5.1 or newer with capability-aware kernelPathPolicy; browsers without shader-f16 run the declared f32 fallback lane.

admission.claimBoundary: Embedding execution and reproducibility do not establish biological function.
Masked-token logits are residue plausibility evidence, not mutation fitness.
The larger representation must show incremental decision value beyond ESM-2.
DNA embeddings do not establish regulation, pathogenicity, or function.
